nuggets.text: The Eagles' famous yellow school buses were bought from the Bulloch County school system for a dollar each.
Erk Russell carried a jug of 'Beautiful Eagle Creek' water to sprinkle on the field at an Eagles playoff game in 1985.
The Eagles have won six FCS national titles, a mark topped only by North Dakota State.
The Eagles beat Florida 26-20 in 2013 without completing a single pass.
The Eagles won the Sun Belt in their first FBS season, only the third team ever to win a league title in year one.
Eagles QB Max Johnson is in his seventh college season, after stops at LSU, Texas A&M and North Carolina.
Eagles QB Max Johnson is the son of Super Bowl-winning QB Brad Johnson and the nephew of coach Mark Richt.
Eagles coach Clay Helton, once a backup QB at Auburn and Houston, won a Rose Bowl as USC's head coach.
Eagles offensive coordinator Ryan Aplin was a two-time Sun Belt Player of the Year at Arkansas State.
The Eagles opened 2026 with a 31-0 win over Charleston Southern, their first shutout since 2023.
